title: Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce)
description:
We are looking for a Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce) who will be responsible for developing complex business needs and providing technical solutions for our Salesforce ecosystem. This person should be flexible to adopt or learn new tools to map the growing business processes as the need arises. This role will report into IT Business Systems team. This role will help positively impact our commercial sales, marketing, agronomy, finance, supply chain, IT & other key business functions with smart, forward-looking solutions and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer, design, develop & support Salesforce Platform (Sales, Service, Marketing/Pardot, Experience Cloud)
  • Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.
  • Develop Apex (classes and triggers), experience building Custom User Interface, including Visualforce pages/Lightning pages, Aura Components and Lightning Web Components.
  • Design and develop sites using Experience Site Builder and customization of experience site interface.
  • Design and develop custom workflows, approval flows as fits the business needs and prepare solution design documents, data flow diagrams, test cases etc. as needed.
  • Adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write / maintain test classes for all custom development.
  • Work directly with business (Commercial Sales & Marketing, Agronomy) understanding the business requirements & provide timely and apt solutions.
  • Closely work with extended IT team developers to design, develop, test, implement & support system solutions primarily in Salesforce Platform.


Qualifications and Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on development & design experience with Salesforce Platform is a MUST
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC/Aura/Visualforce is a MUST
  • General web development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript is a MUST
  • Experience working with large data sets, Salesforce API’s and bulkification is a MUST
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills is a MUST
  • Knowledge of IT SDLC and SOX methodologies is MUST
  • Experience with mobile publisher, Salesforce maps are a big plus
  • Experience with ERP, Datawarehouse, BI/Tableau tools are a big plus
  • Ability to work as part of IT team with clear verbal and written communication
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, and Information Systems is preferred

title: Social Media & Partnerships Manager - Sustainable Brand
description:
******************************************************************

All candidates must submit this form -

*Your resume will not be reviewed if the form is not submitted

******************************************************************


Help scale one of the fastest-growing sustainable brands in North America.


About Us


Billions of plastic straws, cups, and lids are thrown away every day. At SOFi Products, we’re replacing them with paper products that perform like plastic but decompose into nothing.


Our mission: make sustainability effortless for cafés, chains, and coffee lovers everywhere.


We’ve built a community of over 28,000 followers and 50 million views this year and we’re just getting started.


Our products are used in 4,000+ locations across North America, from boutique cafes to major chains.


Now we’re looking for a social media operator and brand builder who can help us turn that momentum into movement.


The Role


You’ll lead SOFi social presence, creator network, and café storytelling - turning viral attention into lasting brand growth.


You’ll manage content calendars, creators, and collaborations that make the plastic-free movement part of coffee culture.


This role blends social growth strategy , creator management , and partnership execution.


If you’ve helped a brand scale from 20K to 100K+ followers, you’ll feel right at home here.


Responsibilities


1. Social Media Growth


  • Own SOFi’s content calendar across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.
  • Drive consistent growth in reach, saves, and followers - not vanity metrics.
  • Write captions that feel human and memorable, aligned with SOFi's tone.
  • Use performance data to refine posting cadence, topics, and formats.
  • Identify trends early and adapt content to stay ahead of the curve.


2. Creator & Café Partnerships


  • Build and manage relationships with creators, baristas, and café owners.
  • Coordinate seeding, gifting, and collabs - from DM outreach to repost scheduling.
  • Ensure content from partners meets brand standards (visual + copy tone).


3. Campaign Execution


  • Turn creative ideas (from the founders or the community) into structured project plans.
  • Coordinate your designer and video editors to deliver posts on time.
  • Manage feedback loops, deadlines, and performance tracking in Monday.
  • Report weekly on content performance, reach, and community growth.


You Should Have


  • 3 - 6 years of experience managing social media for consumer or lifestyle brands.
  • Proven record of scaling accounts from 20K+ to 100K+ followers - ideally with viral content and measurable growth.
  • Comfort working directly with creators and brand partners.
  • Excellent written English - you can write captions that sound native and natural.
  • A balance of creativity and structure - you love organizing ideas into execution.
  • Experience working with U.S. or Canadian brands (bonus if in coffee, CPG, or design-driven products).


Bonus Points
  • You’ve managed influencer seeding campaigns or ambassador programs.
  • You’ve helped a brand go viral on Reels/TikTok and sustained momentum after.
  • You’re skilled at translating performance data into creative action.

title: Transição: De AAI para Consultor de Investimentos e Planejador (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(a) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. 

Você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental, ou seja, alinhar o conhecimento técnico e as formas de tratativa com os clientes, para que eles compreendam as estratégias e como elas se encaixam. 

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil a ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst (BCM)
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.g., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.

  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.

- Closing 6 deals per month minimum

- Frequent virtual events, in-person meetups, and travel opportunities

title: Closer de Vendas PJ (Comercial)
description:
Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de um Closer Jurídico altamente qualificado para reforçar nosso time comercial. Esse profissional será responsável pela captação ativa de clientes e pelo atendimento de leads gerados pelo marketing , atuando na área de Direito Digital e Consumidor.


Se você tem experiência com prospecção, negociação e fechamento de oportunidades, além de um bom entendimento do setor jurídico, essa pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você!


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Prospecção ativa (outbound) de potenciais clientes via telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp e redes sociais.
  • Atendimento e qualificação de leads inbound , identificando dores e necessidades para direcionamento estratégico.
  • Explicação sobre serviços jurídicos do escritório , garantindo que o lead compreenda como podemos ajudá-lo.
  • Uso de gatilhos mentais e técnicas de persuasão para despertar interesse e aumentar conversões.
  • Controle e agendamento de reuniões com clientes.
  • Registro e acompanhamento dos leads no CRM , mantendo informações atualizadas e organizadas.
  • Trabalho alinhado com os demais membros da equipe comercial.
  • Acompanhamento e follow-up de clientes interessados para maximizar taxas de conversão.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas, prospecção ativa ou atendimento comercial.
  • Conhecimento sobre processos jurídicos relacionados ao Direito Civil (não precisa ser advogado, mas deve entender conceitos básicos dessas áreas para argumentação).
  • Habilidade em comunicação persuasiva e negociação , sabendo conduzir objeções e despertar interesse.
  • Familiaridade com CRM (ex: Pipedrive, HubSpot, RD Station, etc.) e metodologias de qualificação de leads (BANT, GPCT, SPIN Selling ).
  • Capacidade de análise e segmentação de clientes, entendendo perfis ideais para cada serviço jurídico .
  • Organização para gerenciar vários contatos simultaneamente e manter follow-ups ativos.
  • Proatividade e mindset voltado para resultados e conversão.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de vendas e prospecção será um diferencial.
  • Escuta ativa.
  • Jogo de cintura.


Modelo de Trabalho e Benefícios:

  • Atuação majoritária em sede física (Ribeirão Preto).
  • Regime de contratação: PJ.
  • Remuneração fixa + bonificação por performance e resultados .
  • Ifood Benefícios.
  • Plano de Carreira e oportunidade de crescimento dentro do escritório.
  • Treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

title: Immigration Case Manager/Paralegal
description:
Company Description

Robinson Immigration Law specializes in helping outstanding researchers, professionals, and entrepreneurs secure U.S. immigration pathways through high-impact visa strategies. The firm focuses on visas such as the EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, E-2, and O-1A. We craft compelling, evidence-based petitions that highlight clients' unique achievements and contributions to the U.S. economy and national interest. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, Robinson Immigration Law offers personalized, expert-led petition strategies and supports clients globally with 100% remote capability.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Immigration Case Manager/Paralegal. The primary day-to-day tasks include managing client cases, drafting and reviewing petitions, conducting legal research, preparing and organizing documents, and maintaining client communication. The role also involves coordinating with the managing attorney to develop case strategies, ensuring compliance with immigration regulations, and assisting clients through each stage of the application process.


Qualifications

  • Case management, document preparation, and client communication skills
  • Legal education or license to practice law
  • Experience with drafting and reviewing immigration petitions and legal documents
  • Legal research and knowledge of immigration law
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely


We have a collaborative, supportive work environment where we value your contributions and input. We offer competitive pay, bonuses, and opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

title: Senior Graphic Artist
description:
About Kore

Kore is the trusted infrastructure for the global private capital markets. Through its suite of connected platforms — Kore, KoreTransfer, KoreChain, KoreWire, KoreID, KoreGPT, Kore Issuance, Kore Platform, KoreClearing, and KoreSummit — Kore unites issuers, investors, and regulated intermediaries across a transparent, compliant, and digitally connected ecosystem.


Design and visual communication play a crucial role in how Kore communicates innovation, trust, and leadership in fintech and compliance-driven markets. Every visual asset — from investor materials to digital campaigns — must reflect our precision, sophistication, and purpose.

Role Overview

The Graphic Artist will lead visual design and creative production for the Kore family of companies, managing all brand, marketing, and multimedia assets across digital and print media.


This role combines brand leadership, creative design, and AI-assisted innovation to ensure Kore’s identity remains consistent, compelling, and globally recognized.


Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and working closely with the VP Technology , Product , and Client Success teams, the Graphic Artist will manage the visual direction for Kore’s platforms and campaigns, ensuring all creative materials align with brand standards and business goals.

The Graphic Artist will also mentor and manage a junior designer , fostering a creative environment that balances speed, quality, and design excellence.

Core Responsibilities 1. Brand & Visual Design Leadership
  • Develop and maintain Kore’s brand identity system , ensuring consistent application across Kore’s subsidiaries and platforms.
  • Produce visual assets for all Kore divisions — Kore, KoreTransfer, KoreChain, KoreWire, KoreID, KoreGPT, Kore Issuance, Kore Platform, KoreClearing, and KoreSummit .
  • Create and maintain brand style guides , color systems, typography standards, and layout frameworks.
  • Partner with the CMO and senior leadership to evolve Kore’s visual storytelling across all touchpoints.
2. Marketing & Corporate Design
  • Design marketing materials including brochures, fact sheets, corporate reports, whitepapers, and investor decks.
  • Create infographics, charts, and diagrams to communicate complex fintech concepts clearly and visually.
  • Develop digital and social media assets for marketing campaigns, press releases, and events.
  • Design presentation templates and visual systems for Kore executives and partner-facing communications.
  • Support KoreSummit with event branding, stage visuals, signage, and multimedia content.
3. Web, Product, and UX Collaboration
  • Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to produce UX/UI assets in Figma and Adobe XD.
  • Translate complex product workflows (KoreChain, KoreClearing, KoreGPT) into visually clear interfaces and infographics .
  • Ensure web design consistency across all Kore websites and partner portals.
  • Support the development of KoreWire and KorePlatform’s front-end experience with responsive visuals and layout guidance.
4. Video & Multimedia
  • Design motion graphics, animated explainers, and promotional videos for social media, investor updates, and product launches.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing and Client Success teams to produce training and onboarding videos for issuers and intermediaries.
  • Maintain video templates, transitions, intros, and lower thirds for Kore’s content channels.
5. AI & Automation Integration
  • Leverage KoreGPT and AI-based design tools (e.g., Adobe Firefly, DALL·E, Runway ML) to accelerate content creation, ideation, and visual enhancement.
  • Automate repetitive creative tasks such as asset resizing, background removal, and layout generation.
  • Experiment with AI-driven visualization tools to generate design concepts aligned with Kore’s brand tone and values.
  • Use KoreGPT to summarize brand guidelines, generate design briefs, and assist in creative ideation sessions.
6. Project & Team Management
  • Manage and mentor a junior designer , assigning projects, reviewing work, and providing constructive feedback.
  • Prioritize and balance multiple design projects under tight deadlines while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Collaborate with the marketing, product, and client success teams to align creative output with campaign goals and client needs.
  • Oversee external vendors or freelancers for specialized design, print, or motion projects when needed.
  • Maintain Kore’s digital asset management system (DAM) to ensure all assets are version-controlled and accessible.
7. Cross-Department Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • CMO – for campaign strategy and brand direction.
  • CRO – for sales presentations and visual sales enablement materials.
  • CBO – for partner program design and visual assets for ecosystem expansion.
  • VP Technology – for UI/UX coordination and product interface visuals.
  • Client Success Team – for training and onboarding materials for issuers and intermediaries.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design

title: Model Outsourcing Artist
description:
Duration: 9 months


Required Skills & Experience

● Experience in shipping AAA titles across multiple platforms.

● Experience shipping high-quality game ready assets for production, with an emphasis on stylized art / stylized realism. ● Must have a strong portfolio showing executed 3D game assets for hard surface and organics.

● Demonstrate a firm understanding of good efficient topology, UVs and textures.

● Strong understanding of latest toolsets in game art creation, including (but not limited to) Unreal Engine 5, Substance Painter, Substance Designer, Perforce, and 3D modeling packages (A plus if experienced with Flow (“Shotgrid”), JIRA and Miro).

● Highly organized, self-driven, customer focused, and a great team player.

● Ability to critique, mentor, and improve art through written and visual feedback loops. Strong emphasis on visual feedback loops.

● A keen understanding of technical restrictions, ability to autonomously make choices to ensure high level art quality consistently, and excellent communication skills are a must.

● Experienced working within a team and a high-pressure production environment.

Job Description

● Work with the Outsource Art Team Lead to ensure that assets from outsourcing partners are delivered to the expected quality level consistently and on schedule.

● Clearly communicate all necessary information to outsourcing partners for needed edits to their deliverables in a concise and visual manner with notations and supporting images and any necessary technical information.

● Deploy and must have a strong knowledge of efficient topology, UVs, textures, and technical aptitude with materials. ● Always relay any information that is relevant in regard to any challenges (technical & artistic) that arise when an outsourcing partner is working on an asset that the Outsource Art Team Lead should be aware of in order to get a solution provided to the outsourcing partner quickly.

● Ensure that outsourcing partner artists understand Psyonix's specific techniques and best practices and use them at all times.

Sua missão:


Conduzir reuniões consultivas, entender a realidade fiscal das empresas, apresentar soluções estratégicas e conduzir o cliente até o fechamento do contrato.

  • Presencial em Curitiba (Centro)
  • EXCELENTE comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Perfil analítico e postura profissional
  • Experiência prévia em negociações ou vendas consultivas
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e CRM


Diferenciais que contam pontos, mas não obrigatórios:

  • Experiência com B2B ou serviços de ticket alto
  • Capacidade de interpretar cenários jurídicos/tributários e financeiros complexos

title: Senior CRM Analyst (Data Science)
description:
Overview

We are seeking a Senior CRM Analyst with strong data science expertise to support data-driven customer engagement strategies for a U.S.-based employer. The ideal candidate will have proven experience analyzing customer data and marketing campaigns, leveraging advanced statistical and data science techniques to drive retention, optimize campaigns, and deliver actionable insights. This role is ideal for a highly analytical professional who can turn raw data into strategic recommendations while also communicating findings effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze customer behavior and campaign performance data to inform retention strategies.
  • Conduct A/B testing, statistical analysis, and data science modeling to optimize campaigns and promotional offers.
  • Build, maintain, and present executive-level dashboards and reports using visualization tools like Looker or Looker Studio.
  • Extract and manipulate data using SQL, BigQuery, and advanced analytics platforms (e.g., Dataiku).
  • Apply machine learning techniques where applicable to enhance customer segmentation and predictive modeling.
  • Deliver ad-hoc data reports and actionable insights to support CRM and marketing decision-making.
  • Present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear, business-focused manner.


Qualifications

  • Proven experience in CRM analysis and data science applications .
  • Hands-on, real-world data science experience at the enterprise level
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and handling large datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with data visualization and dashboard tools (Looker strongly preferred ).
  • Familiarity with CRM/marketing analytics tools (e.g., Braze, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics ).
  • Expertise in statistical modeling, predictive analytics, or machine learning techniques .
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing and customer retention metrics.
  • Impeccable written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and adapt quickly to new platforms or client needs.
  • Willingness to work U.S. hours (Central or Eastern Time).

Nice to Have

  • Experience using Dataiku or BigQuery for advanced data workflows.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and large language model outputs.
  • Experience working with cross-functional data science and marketing teams.
  • Prior client-facing experience in analytics or data consulting.

title: ESPECIALISTA DE BANCO DE DADOS
description:
Somos uma empresa brasileira, com presença internacional, que traz a inovação em seu DNA! Na Biolab, acreditamos que equipes diversas constroem resultados mais sólidos e transformadores. Valorizamos a inclusão e a diversidade em todas as nossas posições . Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e de todas as identidades, histórias e origens.


Responsável por administrar e garantir o funcionamento dos bancos de dados, assegurando sua performance, disponibilidade e segurança. Atua na identificação e implementação de melhorias operacionais e de processos, além de solucionar problemas técnicos e acompanhar o desenvolvimento, manutenção e programação relacionados aos ambientes de dados. Participa de projetos estratégicos, contribuindo para a evolução das soluções de armazenamento, processamento e acesso às informações da organização.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB e Firebase;
  • Domínio da linguagem SQL;
  • Conhecimento avançado em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux;
  • Sólida compreensão de arquitetura de infraestrutura de TI, tanto on premises quanto em ambientes de nuvem (cloud);
  • Conhecimento em licenciamento das principais ferramentas de banco de dados.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência na construção de scripts utilizando PowerShell e Shell Script, ferramentas de monitoração, como Nagios e Zabbix, Metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Agile, ferramentas de análise de performance, como New Relic, SolarWinds, SQL Monitoring e Dynatrace.


CONFIRA ABAIXO AS PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES DESTA POSIÇÃO:

  • Desenvolver e manter scripts, rotinas automatizadas e ferramentas de apoio à administração de dados, utilizando linguagens como Python, Shell Script, PowerShell ou ferramentas de orquestração (como Jenkins e Airflow), com o objetivo de aumentar a eficiência, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos processos relacionados à infraestrutura de dados;
  • Implantar, sustentar e otimizar ambientes de banco de dados relacionais e analíticos, incluindo soluções de processamento distribuído, ETL, mineração de dados e plataformas de inteligência de negócios, assegurando alta disponibilidade, desempenho e uso eficiente de recursos;
  • Prestar suporte técnico ao time de BI e Dados na manutenção e disponibilização de softwares e ferramentas voltadas à extração, navegação e manipulação de dados analíticos (como Power BI, Tableau, Pentaho, entre outros), com o objetivo de garantir o bom uso, segurança e governança da informação;
  • Conduzir projetos de banco de dados de ponta a ponta, desde o planejamento até a implementação, utilizando metodologias ágeis ou tradicionais, com foco na melhoria contínua dos processos, eficiência das atividades e evolução do ambiente de dados;
  • Atuar como interlocutor técnico em reuniões e comitês com áreas de negócio, promovendo o entendimento de necessidades e identificando problemas relacionados a dados e sistemas, a fim de propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da organização.


Para saber mais sobre nós, acesse e siga nossas redes sociais.

title: Auxiliar Operacional Externo
description:
VAGA: AUXILIAR OPERACIONAL EXTERNO - SETOR IMOBILIÁRIO


Goiânia/GO - Setor Bueno | Presencial | Trabalho em Campo (Moto)


A BRAVO IMOBILIÁRIA está em expansão e busca profissional dinâmico para atuar no departamento operacional, realizando visitas a imóveis, gestão de obras e atendimento externo a clientes.


⚠️ ATENÇÃO: Esta vaga exige CNH A - MOBILIDADE (moto) para deslocamentos frequentes pela cidade.


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS:


• Realizar visitas supervisionadas a imóveis para clientes potenciais

• Apresentar propriedades destacando características e benefícios

• Acompanhar e fiscalizar obras, reformas e reparos em imóveis

• Gerenciar prestadores de serviço (obtenção de orçamentos e acompanhamento)

• Realizar diligências externas (entregas de documentos, chaves, vistorias)

• Atender clientes em campo e responder dúvidas sobre imóveis

• Prospectar oportunidades de captação de novos imóveis

• Apoiar processos administrativos e comunicação entre departamentos


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:


  • Ensino Médio Completo
  • CNH Categoria A (ativa e válida)
  • Moto própria para deslocamentos
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho externo em período integral
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia


DIFERENCIAIS:


• Experiência prévia em atendimento ao cliente

• Conhecimento do mercado imobiliário de Goiânia

• Experiência com gestão de obras ou prestadores de serviço

• Habilidade em negociação


REMUNERAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS:


• Salário Fixo: R$ 2.000,00

• Comissões por resultados (sem teto!)

• Vale Transporte

• Assistência saúde

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (ATS integration / automation)
description:
Why Asendia AI

Asendia AI is a fast-growing B2B SaaS startup redefining how staffing agencies source, screen, and hire candidates, powered by voice AI, automation, and agentic workflows.

We help staffing teams screen and verify candidates at scale through automated voice interviews, candidate scoring, and seamless ATS integrations.

We’re already powering 24/7 interview and verification systems across the US and Europe, working with staffing leaders to eliminate manual screening, fraud, and inefficiencies in recruiting.

We’re a small, high-performance team backed by deep staffing industry knowledge, building the next AI recruitment unicorn.

You’ll find us exhibiting at events like TechServe Alliance, Staffing World, Collaboration X, and Europe Tech Summit, shaping the future of staffing automation.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a senior Full-Stack Engineer to own the architecture, design, and development of our AI platform.

You’ll work directly with the founders to build real-time voice systems, data-driven scoring pipelines, and ATS integrations that redefine how recruiters work.

This is a ground-floor role with massive ownership. You’ll shape both product and tech direction.


What You’ll Build

  • AI Interview Engine: Develop real-time AI interviews with FastAPI and WebSocket streaming.
  • Candidate Scoring Logic: Design algorithms to transform voice conversations into structured performance scores.
  • ATS Integrations: Build secure, scalable two-way syncs with ATS/CRM platforms.
  • Recruiter Dashboard: Develop modern React/Next.js dashboards for analytics, workflows, and reports.
  • Agentic Automation: Create tools for recruiters to customize AI workflows, scoring logic, and voice personalities.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Deploy and scale globally on Azure (Functions, AKS, Cosmos DB) with monitoring and CI/CD.
  • Problems You’ll SolveHow do we maintain <300ms latency in live AI interviews at a global scale?
  • How can we fine-tune models to reduce hallucination and increase scoring accuracy?
  • How do we scale from hundreds to tens of thousands of concurrent sessions?
  • What’s the fastest and cleanest way to sync AI-generated data into enterprise ATS systems?
  • How do we make real-time analytics and dashboards instantly responsive for recruiters?
  • How do we design secure, customizable AI workflows for every client while keeping a unified backend?

Who You Are

  • 4–7 years in full-stack engineering (Python/FastAPI, React/Next.js, Node.js).
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud and real-time API architectures.
  • Product-minded engineer. You care about users and outcomes, not just code.
  • High-agency, ownership-driven, and comfortable in ambiguity.
  • Bonus: experience with speech/NLP, LLMs, or agentic frameworks.
  • What’s In It For YouTake ownership of building a billion-dollar product from the ground up.
  • Collaborate daily with founders and industry experts.
  • Ship fast, see your impact directly in production and customer success.
  • Competitive salary
  • Hybrid-first with team offsites, conference participation, and big learning opportunities.
  • Be part of a small team building the future of recruiting with agentic AI.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.


Contract Type


Full-time

description:

Contratação PJ


O Grupo Ivy está em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar alocado(a) em um de nossos clientes: uma pensiontech B2B2C, que tem como missão transformar o setor de previdência privada complementar com tecnologia própria e foco em excelência no relacionamento com o cliente.


Buscamos alguém com perfil organizado, autônomo, boa comunicação e que saiba navegar entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, com domínio do ciclo completo de gestão de projetos e entregas digitais.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes desde o início do projeto, realizar levantamento de requisitos e documentar escopos
  • Planejar e conduzir reuniões de kickoff e acompanhamento
  • Criar tarefas, montar e manter cronogramas, acompanhando execuções ponta a ponta
  • Validar entregas da equipe de desenvolvimento antes da homologação pelo cliente
  • Promover o uso estruturado de ferramentas como Jira e Confluence
  • Atuar com metodologias ágeis, preferencialmente Kanban, e facilitar a comunicação entre o time técnico e as áreas de negócio


Requisitos

  • Experiência com gestão de projetos e/ou produtos digitais com foco em entrega
  • Vivência com times de desenvolvimento de software e habilidade de interlocução técnica
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Jira, Confluence e metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Capacidade de organizar demandas, documentar entregas e lidar com múltiplos stakeholders
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida: 2 dias por semana presencial em Faria Lima – SP


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em fintechs, bancos digitais ou startups
  • Conhecimento técnico (mesmo que básico) em desenvolvimento de software
  • Vivência em mapeamento de jornadas e processos


Se interessou?


Se candidate e vamos conversar.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Industry： Renewables & Environment/Solar (PV) utility scale projects


Job Responsibilities:

1、Be responsible for guiding the construction team at the project site to count equipment and materials, and provide training on the installation of photovoltaic brackets.

2、Be responsible for tracking the debugging and troubleshooting of bracket products, and provide on-site support according to the contract with the client.

3、Cooperate with the project manager to recover the acceptance signature forms of each stage of the project as soon as possible based on the delivery progress.

4、Truthfully report any issues related to our company's business that occur at the project site and actively seek solutions.

5、Maintain good communication with the R&D and quality teams.

6、Maintain good relationships with clients and protect the company's image.


Job Requirements:

1、College degree or above, with a background in engineering, majoring in mechanical and electrical, electrical, architecture or related fields;

2、Over 5 years of working experience, engaged in the construction, installation, operation and maintenance of photovoltaic power stations, and in technical support positions;

3、Familiar with goods delivery, on-site construction and quality management

title: Linguistics Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing



Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.


If interested, kindly share your resume at:

title: Workday Developer
description:
This role is with our client in Brazil who are expanding their team


Workday Enhancement Developer

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil - 2 times per week onsite.

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking a Workday Enhancement Developer to design, build, and implement scalable enhancements and integrations across our Workday platform. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Workday configuration, reporting, and business process optimization, with a strong ability to partner with HR, Finance, and IT stakeholders to continuously improve system functionality and user experience.

This role is critical to enabling digital HR transformation by developing custom solutions that align with business needs and global compliance standards.


Key Responsibilities

1. Workday Development & Enhancements

  • Design, configure, and deploy enhancements within the Workday HCM, Compensation, Recruiting, Payroll, and/or Absence modules.
  • Develop and maintain advanced Workday Studio integrations , EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder) , and Core Connectors .
  • Implement calculated fields, custom reports, dashboards, and Workday Extend applications where applicable.
  • Customize and automate business processes to streamline HR operations.


2. Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify system optimization opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Evaluate Workday’s semi-annual releases, assess impact, and implement new features/enhancements where beneficial.
  • Support change requests, bug fixes, and configuration updates with proper testing and documentation.


3. Technical Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain technical design documents, configuration guides, and integration maps.
  • Ensure all enhancements comply with data security, GDPR, and SOX requirements.
  • Support system governance, access management, and configuration audit controls.


4. Collaboration & Support

  • Partner with HRIS, HR, Finance, and IT teams to deliver end-to-end process improvements.
  • Provide tier-3 support for production incidents, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
  • Mentor junior Workday analysts/developers and promote best practices in Workday development lifecycle.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, HR Technology, or a related field.
  • 3–6 years of hands-on Workday experience , including configuration and integration development.
  • Proficiency in:
  • Workday Studio , EIBs , Core Connectors , Workday Report Writer , and calculated fields .
  • Workday Business Process Framework (BPF) configuration and troubleshooting.
  • XSLT , XML , SOAP/REST APIs , and Web Services integration.
  • Strong understanding of HR, Payroll, and Talent Management functional processes.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodology.

title: Supervisor de loja - Itaqua Park Shopping
description:
#VEMSERCAEDU


Há 50 anos , atuamos no varejo de moda com o propósito de compartilhar o que temos de melhor para vestir histórias mais felizes .


Estamos presentes em São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Goiás, Distrito Federal e Minas Gerais , com mais de 100 lojas e um time apaixonado pelo que faz.


Aqui na Caedu , acreditamos em um ambiente alegre, acolhedor e cheio de oportunidades de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional . Valorizamos a diversidade , o respeito , o senso de dono e o trabalho em equipe porque sabemos que juntos somos mais fortes .


Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito, valores sólidos e espaço para crescer, vem ser Caedu! ✨

Quais serão suas atividades?


Supervisão das operações de loja:

Acompanhar e garantir a execução dos processos de organização, exposição de produtos, reposição, arrumação, estoque, distribuição, fiscalização, atendimento do provador e área de vendas, assegurando o cumprimento dos procedimentos internos, check list e padrões estabelecidos pela empresa.


Gestão de produtos e serviços financeiros:

Controlar as operações de cartão e qualidade cadastral, acompanhando e treinando a equipe nos procedimentos de indicação, captação, atendimento e análise de documentos, garantindo a correta emissão e validação dos termos de adesão junto aos clientes.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
Smurfit Westrock is a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging, operates in 40 countries with over 500 packaging converting operations and 63 paper mills. With the circular economy at the core of our business, we use renewable, recyclable, and recycled materials to create sustainable packaging solutions. Having over 100k employees, and 300k acres of forestry, we are committed supporting the environment, employees, and the communities where we operate.


About the role:

The internal audit team is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor , who will report to the Senior Manager - LATAM and will be responsible for executing assurance and advisory Internal Audit projects including financial, enterprise risk and Sarbanes-Oxley testing activities included within the Internal Audit plan.


This role will support the department's aspiration of creating a strong risk/control assurance function, being consistently sought out for risk/control advisory services, delivering respected, valued, data-driven risk/control insights, and positively influencing the continuous improvement of the changing global risk/control environment.


Candidate Background & knowledge

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar)
  • At least 5- 6 years’ experience with a Large Public Accounting/Consulting Firm (Audit or Advisory Services serving public companies) as well as industry experience with a large Public Company Internal Audit and/or SOX department.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills both verbal and electronic formats in English and Portuguese. In Spanish is a plus
  • Ability to independently lead and deliver quality audits in various operations within the business
  • Strong Training skills - Ability to coach, mentor challenge and empower members of the team
  • Strong Leadership skills – Driver of improvements and efficiencies
  • A forward thinker and problem solver, committed to achieve goals, driven and self-motivated
  • Ability to prioritise and adopt the 80/20 rule and to meet deadlines
  • Available to travel approximately 40%, nationally and internationally


Desired Skills:

  • Data analytic and Power BI skills, utilizing data and transactions to identify errors and provide business insights
  • Fluent Spanish is a plus


What we offer:

  • An attractive salary reflecting skills, competencies and potential
  • Work life balance through flexible hours and hybrid working
  • Comprehensive training with numerous learning and development opportunities
  • National and international professional travels, exposure and progression
  • A career with a global packaging company where Sustainability, Safety and Inclusion are business drivers and foundational elements of the daily work
  • Corporate culture based on integrity, respect, accountability and excellence


Smurfit Westrock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to create and maintain a diverse workforce where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Smurfit Westrock does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Shopify Web Designer
description:
Company Description

Step Labs is a web development and design agency dedicated to partnering with 7-8 figure e-commerce brands to drive revenue growth. We focus on helping ambitious founders scale their businesses efficiently through research-focused split tests. Our custom revenue growth systems guarantee a 30% revenue uplift within 3 months through weekly split-tests. We are passionate about helping our clients achieve measurable success and sustainable growth.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Shopify focussed Web Designer. The Shopify Web Designer will be responsible for designing and implementing high-quality, responsive web designs. Day-to-day tasks include graphic design, front-end development, and creating graphics that enhance the user experience. The web designer will collaborate closely with our team to ensure that all designs align with our clients' brand identity and contribute to their revenue growth.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Web Design and Responsive Web Design
  • Fluency in English - do not apply if you are not fluent in english﻿
  • Strong skills with autolayout in Figma, and with creating high-quality graphics in Adobe CC
  • Experience working with Shopify and an understanding of e-commerce design principles
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote setting
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing project requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Web Design, Graphic Design, or a related field is preferred
  • Experience in conducting user research and implementing data-driven design changes is a plus

title: 11001 - Head Comercial (SMB)
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Head Comercial, que será responsável pela liderança de toda a operação comercial voltada à conversão de novos clientes de pequeno e médio porte, garantindo o crescimento sustentável da base ativa e a expansão da presença da empresa no segmento SMB!✨


Principais responsabilidades:

Liderar a operação de vendas para o segmento SMB (pequenas e médias empresas), com foco na conversão de leads qualificados em contratos assinados;

Garantir a performance das estruturas comerciais voltadas para SMB, incluindo canais diretos de venda, inbound e outbound;

Acompanhar os principais indicadores da operação: taxa de conversão, tempo médio de fechamento, qualidade de performance dos closers e evolução de pipeline;

Atuar diretamente na gestão de líderes dos times de vendas SMB, promovendo o desenvolvimento das equipes;

Conduzir reuniões de forecast, alinhamento de metas, revisão de processos e acompanhamento da jornada do lead até o fechamento do contrato;

Assegurar que a abordagem comercial esteja alinhada à proposta de valor da empresa, considerando o portfólio completo de soluções: viagens corporativas, mobilidade, carteira digital, gestão de reembolsos, cartões corporativos e gestão de despesas;

Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Marketing, Pré-Vendas, Onboarding, Customer Success e Produto para potencializar a performance comercial;

Contribuir na estruturação de playbooks, processos e treinamentos voltados para o segmento SMB;

Reportar-se à Diretoria Executiva de Novos Negócios, apresentando indicadores, planos de ação e resultados da unidade.


Requisitos:

Graduação completa, sem restrição de área;

Experiência comprovada em cargos de liderança sênior em vendas B2B para clientes de pequeno e médio porte;

Histórico de atuação com vendas para empresas de pequeno e médio porte, em ciclos comerciais de alta cadência;

Conhecimento das dinâmicas de vendas por canais diretos, inbound e outbound;

Vivência na estruturação e gestão de equipes comerciais de alto desempenho;

Inglês em nível intermediário;

Domínio de CRM (preferencialmente HubSpot) e ferramentas de acompanhamento de funil e forecast;

Experiência consolidada na liderança de estruturas de vendas SMB em empresas de tecnologia, mobilidade ou soluções corporativas;

Atuação anterior com times comerciais de alta cadência e conversão, em ambientes de crescimento acelerado;

Vivência em ambientes que envolvam múltiplos produtos e soluções integradas;

Experiência na gestão de líderes e coordenações de vendas.


✔Contratação: CLT + Benefícios

✔Local: Belo Horizonte/MG (Híbrido, 2 dias presenciais na semana)

title: Analista de Commercial Intelligence Sr.  – Beleza & Luxo
description:
A SMART BEAUTY , filial brasileira do Diffugroup — grupo com mais de 40 anos de atuação na América Latina e responsável pela gestão de mais de 60 marcas de cosméticos e fragrâncias de luxo — está em expansão e busca um(a) Analista Sênior de Commercial Intelligence para fortalecer a área comercial e estratégica da companhia.


Local: São Paulo – Brooklin (presencial)

️ Departamento: Comercial / Estratégia

Nível: Sênior

Reporta para: Diretor Comercial


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por números, performance e beleza, com perfil analítico, visão estratégica e foco em resultado.

Essa posição será responsável por conectar dados e estratégia, transformando informações comerciais em decisões inteligentes que impulsionem o crescimento das marcas de luxo do nosso portfólio — que inclui Dolce & Gabbana, Versace, Moschino, Michael Kors, Naj Oleari, Moroccanoil, Clean Beauty, Pupa Milano, Atkinsons, Brunello Cucinelli , entre outras.

O(a) Analista atuará de forma próxima à Diretoria Comercial, apoiando decisões estratégicas e sendo uma peça-chave na definição de preços, performance e rentabilidade por canal, cliente e categoria. Essa posição é o primeiro passo para evoluir a cargos de liderança em Business Intelligence e Estratégia Comercial.


Se você é analítico, curioso, tem visão de negócio e quer crescer em um ambiente de alta performance e ritmo acelerado, essa vaga é para você.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Short-term Project)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Mobile Engineer with 7+ years of professional experience in mobile application development to work for our U.K. / U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in native or cross-platform framework development to make tech stack and architectural decisions, as well as build an initial MVP that will become a core tool powering the client's operations and data delivery.

title: Marketing Content Specialist
description:
Marketing Content Specialist


How to Stand Out


When applying, send an email to and please include:

  • In the subject line write the subject line from the top of this job description.
  • Your answer to this question: if you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?
  • Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "The best way to know any future is to cause one"
  • Three content samples (ads, reels, or emails)


Department: Marketing

Type: Full-Time (Remote)

Pay Range: $1,500 – $2,200 USD / month + performance bonus


About the Role


Your mission: capture real customer wins and turn them into daily content across ads, social, and email. This role owns the proof-fed Ad Factory that delivers “more, better, new” creatives every week.

Raw > polished. Volume > perfection. Consistency compounds.


What You'll Do


  • Harvest Proof: collect screenshots, testimonials, videos, reviews, and milestones weekly.
  • Build Ads: use AI tools (ChatGPT, Descript, Claude, OpusClip, Canva AI) to write hooks, edit clips, and assemble 10–50 ad variants/week.
  • Publish Daily: post proof-driven content on FB, IG, YT, TikTok, LinkedIn + send 2 emails/week.
  • Track Performance: monitor creative winners and cost per engaged lead.


Success Metrics


  • 10–50 new ad variants / week
  • Daily organic posts across platforms
  • 2 emails / week built from real proof
  • 70 % + of content sourced from actual customer wins

You Are


  • A fast executor who loves shipping daily
  • Skilled at short-form editing (CapCut / Descript / OpusClip)
  • Comfortable writing short copy (hooks / CTAs / captions)
  • AI-native — you already use ChatGPT or Claude in your workflow
  • Organized, fluent in English, and hungry to learn


Compensation


  • Full-Time $1,500 – $2,200 USD / month
  • $100–$300 bonus for hitting output + ROI goals


Stack


ChatGPT • Claude • Descript • OpusClip • Canva • Lumen5 • CapCut • Publer • HubSpot / HighLevel • Notion • Zapier / Make

title: Assessor de imprensa
description:
Você é Assessor de Imprensa e deseja viver a melhor experiência da sua carreira?


A V3COM , agência de comunicação e relações públicas, que está classificada entre as 5 maiores do sul do Brasil, está com uma vaga aberta para início imediato !


Sua missão será zelar pela reputação do cliente, criando conexões de valor com o mercado, stakeholders e a sociedade, com o objetivo de contribuir para a construção de histórias V3rdadeiras.


Você será responsável por:


  • Construir e executar estratégias de relacionamento com a mídia;
  • Analisar e acompanhar diariamente o clipping;
  • Elaborar releases, notas, planejamentos, comunicados oficiais, artigos técnicos e outros materiais planejados;
  • Elaborar Media Kit, check points e acompanhar porta-vozes em entrevistas virtuais e presenciais;
  • Acompanhar o cliente em premiações e eventos externos quando necessário;
  • Executar estratégias de divulgação que garantam exposição em veículos relevantes;
  • Criar e manter relacionamento próximo com jornalistas e imprensa a nível nacional;
  • Elaborar relatórios mensais de atividades e resultados, avaliar concorrentes e trazer inovação e insights para aprimorar nossos processos e estratégia de PR.


Requisitos indispensáveis:

  • Formação superior completa em Comunicação, Jornalismo, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em comunicação externa e corporativa no segmento Educacional;
  • Excelente habilidade de redação;
  • Amplo conhecimento e relacionamento com jornalistas;
  • Nível de senioridade: Pleno;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens municipais no Rio Grande do Sul;
  • Atuação remota em Porto Alegre.


Diferenciais:

  • Boa desenvoltura e postura para atuar com executivos de alto nível;
  • Agilidade em se familiarizar com o segmento de atuação do cliente;
  • Conhecimento prévio com ferramentas de gestão de atividade, gestão de assessoria de imprensa e inteligência artificial;
  • Foco em resultados (ter cases de grande repercussão são diferenciais).


Não conseguiu se candidatar? Envie o seu currículo no nosso e-mail

title: SAP Analyst - MDM
description:
Job Title: SAP MDM Analyst

Employment Type: Contract

Work Type: Remote/ Brazil

Languages: Fluent in Portugese and proficiency in English


Required Skills & Qualifications:


Technical & Functional Skills:

  • SAP Master Data Management (MDM) – strong experience in managing Material Master Data (creation, modification, activation/deactivation).
  • SAP MM (Materials Management) – understanding of material master views and integration with procurement/supply chain processes.
  • Experience with Data Quality Tools (DQT) :
  • Data validation, correction, analysis, and reporting
  • Experience working with GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) tools – especially in data governance contexts
  • Familiarity with CIGNON – global process/ticket management system (CR creation, analysis, etc.)
  • NEXT GEN reservation and configuration management
  • Experience in creating or managing ID managers (MEWS)
  • Proficiency in using SAP for requester and DDL (Department Data Lead) configurations

Documentation & Communication:

  • Ability to create work instructions , process documents, and procedures
  • Regular participation in meetings with stakeholders (weekly meetings with DDLs, requesters, and internal teams)
  • Strong communication skills for onboarding new requesters and guiding data stakeholders

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Ability to work in cross-functional and global teams
  • Comfortable with process improvement and standardization initiatives

Language Requirements:

  • Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in English is likely needed for communication with global teams

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Configuração avançada de Salesforce Service Cloud: Cases, Queues, Assignment Rules, Case Routing e Escalation Rules;
  • Implementação de Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case e Chat/Messaging para aplicativos e web;
  • Administração de Knowledge Base, Macros, Quick Text, Omni Supervisor, Entitlements e Milestones;
  • Configuração avançada de Omni-Channel: Routing Configurations, Presence Status, Service Channels e Routing Rules;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias de priorização e balanceamento de carga entre filas e agentes.
  • Utilização de Omni-Channel Flow (nova arquitetura por Flow Builder);
  • Integrações com canais digitais e sistemas complementares.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência com Digital Engagement (WhatsApp, SMS, Web Chat, Facebook Messenger etc.);
  • Experiência com Service Cloud Voice (Amazon Connect, Genesys, Talkdesk ou similar);
  • Integrações com Experience Cloud e bots (Einstein Bots, Azion, Sensedia etc.);
  • Administração e automação Salesforce (Flows, Process Builder, Validation Rules, Permission Sets, Dynamic Forms);
  • Familiaridade com Custom Metadata Types, Record Types e App Builder;
  • Boas práticas de governança e versionamento;
  • Deploy via Change Sets/Azure DevOps/SFDX;
  • Conhecimento de User Stories, Test Plans e Cutover Plans;
  • Mapeamento de processos de atendimento e desenho de jornada do cliente.


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Certificação: Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant;
  • Certificação: Salesforce Administrator / Advanced Administrator;
  • Certificação: Salesforce OmniStudio Developer (ou) Platform App Builder;
  • Experiência com projetos de alto volume de atendimento (call center, SAC, suporte técnico, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em reporting e dashboards para KPIs de atendimento (SLA, FCR, CSAT, backlog).


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de Dono;
  • Foco no Cliente.

title: Senior HRBP LATAM
description:
We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution
